            if ws.cell(row, col).value == header_name:
                return row, col
    raise ValueError(f"Header {header_name!r} not found in {ws.title}")

s1_spend_header_row, s1_spend_col = find_header_col(ws1, 'Actual Spend')
s2_amt_header_row, s2_amt_col = find_header_col(ws2, 'Amount')
s2_ref_header_row, s2_ref_col = find_header_col(ws2, 'Reference')

        if ws.cell(row, col).value is not None:
            last = row
    return last

s2_start = max(s2_amt_header_row, s2_ref_header_row) + 1

    if isinstance(amt, (int, float)):

    elif amt is None:
        amounts_by_ref[ref] += 0

            amounts_by_ref[ref] += 0
            has_amount_for_ref[ref] = True

for row in range(2, 4):

    # If no reference in Sheet1, leave the target cell unchanged.

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
